scope: Connected 700 Mollien, 701 Salon Denon, 702 Daru, 711 Salle des États. Evidence-backed geometry and current room identities; no claim of a complete surveyed digital twin.
critical_corrections: Salle Mollien is 700; Salle Daru is 702.
Do not use the la-salle-daru.jpg filename as a current-placement source.

Room 715 is far west, not between Salon Denon and Salle des États.

Modern711 ceiling is plain white around a broad gridded skylight; do not copy red-gallery gilding or an invented fresco.
Pastoral Concert and Tintoretto SelfPortrait currently non exposé; Bella Nani currently LouvreAbuDhabi. Do not claim them currentroom711.
